description: Array interface for SEL beam elements.
note: 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.sel.beamarray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{beam} or float{beam,3}
functions.description: Get the beam extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: force_axial
functions.description: Get a numpy array of the force axial in beam.

functions.name: ids
functions.description: Get the beam ids as an array.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return beam group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Get a numpy array of the beam length.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.sel.beamarray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{beam} or float{beam,3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the beam extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.sel.beamarray.set_group(membership: array bool{nbeam}, group_name: str, slot="default") -> None
functions.description: Set beam group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding block to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: strain_axial
functions.description: Get a numpy array of the strain axial in beam.

functions.name: stress_axial
functions.description: Get a numpy array of the stress axial in beam.
